item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both attached screenshots. Show the home screen pic first, then the workout screen pic, and finish with the app name, FitTrack. Keep it clean and energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** I checked a read-only production estimate.

### 10-second version: **207 credits**
- Home screenshot, 4 seconds: **96 credits**
- Workout screenshot, 4 seconds: **96 credits**
- “FitTrack” end card, 2 seconds: **0 credits**
- Upbeat instrumental: **15 credits** — minimum 15-second music generation, trimmed to fit

Output would be **16:9 at 480p**, using free-plan-compatible settings. AI animation can distort small UI text, so this isn’t my recommended approach for screenshots.

### Cheaper options
| Option | Estimated credits |
|---|---:|
| 6 seconds: home 2s → workout 2s → FitTrack 2s, with music | **111** |
| Same 6-second version, silent | **96** |
| Static screenshot slideshow with music | **15**, if the screenshots are supplied as downloadable image URLs |

**I recommend the slideshow:** it preserves your screenshots exactly and avoids paying for AI-generated motion. The current slideshow tool needs downloadable URLs rather than the attached Magic Hour asset paths, so that route requires accessible image links first.

480p is already the lowest supported resolution for this production route; shortening or avoiding generated motion saves more.

Also, Magic Hour’s current guidance says **commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or another paid arrangement**—relevant if you’ll publish this as an ad.

Would you prefer the **207-credit animated version**, the **111-credit shorter version**, or the **slideshow route**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the 15-credit slideshow route, keeping it 10 seconds with the upbeat instrumental and no voiceover.

dialog.agent:
Yes—**10 seconds, 16:9, upbeat instrumental, no voiceover**, with a **15-credit budget**:

- **0–4s:** Home screenshot
- **4–8s:** Workout screenshot
- **8–10s:** “FitTrack” end card

One blocker remains: the slideshow tool needs **direct downloadable image URLs**; it can’t use the attached Magic Hour file paths to hold the screenshots unchanged.

Please send a direct image URL for each screenshot. **I haven’t spent any credits**, and I’ll wait until both images are usable before generating the music.
dialog.user: I only have the attached app-home.png and app-workout.png, not direct image URLs. How can I make those usable for the 15-credit slideshow?

dialog.agent:
You don’t need to recreate the screenshots—just make the original PNGs accessible through downloadable links.

**Two options:**

1. **Use a file host:** Download both attachments, upload them to a service that provides direct image links, then paste those links here. Each link must return the PNG itself without a login—not a preview or sharing page. Only use public hosting if you’re comfortable making the screenshots accessible.

2. **Ask Magic Hour support for downloadable URLs** for the two existing asset paths. That could avoid uploading them elsewhere. I don’t have a tool here that converts those paths into download links.

Once I have usable links, I can attempt the exact-image slideshow: **4 seconds home → 4 seconds workout → 2 seconds “FitTrack,”** with the upbeat instrumental.

I should clarify my earlier quote: **15 credits covers the music; the slideshow assembly is credit-free, but currently blocked by the image-link requirement.** Nothing has been charged.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The cheapest option is the **15-credit slideshow**, but I still need downloadable links for the screenshots to assemble it. Your approval doesn’t remove that technical blocker.

Please download the two attachments, upload them to a host that provides direct PNG links, and paste those links here. Hosting costs, if any, are separate from Magic Hour credits.

**I haven’t generated the music or spent credits**, so you won’t be charged for an unfinished slideshow.
